title: Guillermo Zuany, Former Chihuahua Prosecutor, Flees to US and Comes Under Government Protection
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by[La Jornada Editorial
Staff](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [November 12, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/12/politica/guillermo-
zuany-ex-fiscal-de-chihuahua-huye-a-eu-y-queda-bajo-proteccion-del-gobierno-
nyt), Mexico’s premier left wing daily newspaper._

Chihuahua’s former prosecutor for Strategic Operations and Anti-Kidnapping,
Guillermo Zuany, fled to the United States and is **under the protection of
that country’s government** , U.S. and Mexican officials told _The New York
Times_ this Thursday on condition of anonymity.

Last Tuesday, the U.S. newspaper reported that Zuany had allegedly
collaborated with the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) in an operation
carried out in the Sierra Tarahumara, a case in which the state’s former
attorney general, César Jáuregui, faces proceedings for the crimes of
**treason and unlawful exercise of public office**.

According to the newspaper, for more than six months beginning last year,
Zuany coordinated **CIA agents who trained Chihuahua’s security forces** in
missions against the cartels and contributed their expertise during ground
operations.

According to the sources consulted by the newspaper, the former official fled
to U.S. territory to avoid arrest after it became known that the Federal
Attorney General’s Office (FGR) has active arrest warrants.

_The New York Times_ reported that, as of this Thursday, Zuany’s whereabouts
in the United States were unknown.
